messages.subject: [Diagnosismed-list] Position opening in your area
messages.body_plain:
We've found your contact details at one of Job Search Websites.

Currently we have Mystery shopper position available in our company, and if you are still looking for a job,
we would be more than happy to offer you a new challenging position.

So what is basically Mystery shopping? Mystery shopping is commonly used in a variety of different industries such as
retail, restaurants, financial institutions, convenience stores and gas stations, manufacturers, department stores,
travel and entertainment,  the list is endless.


Mystery shopper visits different businesses posing as ordinary customer and provides detailed evaluations of
his/her experience using written reports or questionnaires.
As a Mystery Shopper you will be required to act as a customer of a store meanwhile observing the staff,
the surroundings, and the quality of the goods or services offered.

Our company will give you a certain scenario to use.
Some instruction forms are very detailed, others lack certain details, and some even ask that you come prepared
with a scenario that you have created yourself. 

Fully paid training, advices for improvement and different shopping opportunities are provided to all Mystery shopper
applicants in our company.

Mystery shoppers are either getting paid a pre-arranged fee for a particular shop,
a reimbursement for a purchase or a combination of both.

Therefore in the application form which will be sent to you we kindly ask you to specify your bank details
so we could be able to proceed with a money transfer needed for your assignment.

In other words, financial support will be provided so you won?t need to spend your own money.

The money will be transferred to you beforehand and the detailed instruction form will be sent through
email so you will definitely have enough time to read the directions for completing the assignment.

Please complete all assignments on time. If you absolutely cannot complete an assignment,
contact our representatives immediately so they can reschedule the assignment.
Dependable shoppers get the best assignments!

If our offer kindled your interest, do not hesitate and submit us your personal data
and our representative will contact you during the week:
your name
your phone number
your street address
your email address

We sincerely thank you for the time you spent reading this and look forward to starting working with you.

More details you can learn contacting us at Tracey at businesinsiders.com,Best regards,

Tracey Clements
Assistant HR director
